LightningComponentBundle.description: B2B - Quantitative account-health gauge (0-100) with a SVG donut, verdict level (Excellent / Healthy / Watch / At risk / Critical) and the list of weighted signals used in the computation.

property.name: revenueThreshold
property.label: Revenue threshold
property.description: AnnualRevenue below this counts as a negative signal.

property.name: staleVisitThresholdDays
property.label: Stale-visit threshold (days)
property.description: Uses Account.SDO_MAPS_Days_Since_Last_Visit__c - skipped if the field is absent.
